'''Daniel Meyer''' (also published as '''Dan Meyer''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 113 from Forest City, Iowa. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> He played at the [[2001 Mirkwood Team Tournament]] in Minnesota in 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down pod racing with inserts and counter assaults]], according to Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2514">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-our-moms-think-were-cool-at-mirkwoodd2514/ our-moms-think-were-cool-at-mirkwood], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-our-moms-think-were-cool-at-mirkwoodd2514/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
